subject: Procurement & invoicing: pilots — PO vs card and invoice requirements
body:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Greene <agreene@greenlogistics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement & invoicing: pilots — PO vs card and invoice requirements

Alex — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and a few asks so we can line up procurement and billing for the pilot.

Summary of call:
- Pilot scope: 2 dev seats, 1 production integration for invoice-parsing pipeline; expected monthly usage ~500k tokens.
- Timeline: aim to start provisioning week of Mar 15 if procurement paperwork delivered.
- Success metric: latency under 350ms p95 for endpoint + accuracy baseline on test prompts.

Open commercial/procurement items (asks):
1) Procurement path — will you run this on a corporate card, or do you need a PO process? If PO, who is the purchasing contact and what lead time is typical?
2) Marketplace interest — any preference for buying via AWS Marketplace or direct invoicing? (Marketplace can speed procurement for some customers but requires different invoice flow.)
3) Invoice requirements — please confirm: net terms (net-30, net-45), PO number placement, required line items, tax/VAT ID, billing address, and any specific invoice format (PDF with PO line, EDI, etc.).
4) W-9 / vendor setup — tell us if you need a W-9 or additional vendor paperwork; happy to provide our W-9 and DUNS.

Attachments: pricing-sheet.pdf (summary), draft-sow.docx (scope/shipping).

Next steps we propose:
- You send procurement preferences and billing contact (copy procurement@ if helpful).
- If PO is required, please share a sample PO or template so our finance team can align invoice fields.
- We will produce a sample invoice and send W-9.

If easier, we can loop in our billing ops (cc'ing Rishi to help with vendor setup once we have the requirements).

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0126


From: Alex Greene <agreene@greenlogistics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Cc: Emily Park <emily.park@greenlogistics.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement & invoicing: pilots — PO vs card and invoice requirements

Thanks Marissa — good call. A few notes from procurement/finance side:

- Procurement path: GreenLogistics prefers to issue a PO for pilots > $10k. For this pilot scope we will use a PO.
- Marketplace: we are evaluating AWS Marketplace for longer-term purchases, but for the initial pilot procurement wants a direct PO (simpler for our internal tracking).
- Net terms: net-30 is fine.
- Invoice fields: please include a single-line PO number (we'll provide it), GL legal name and billing address on the invoice, our tax ID (below), and an itemized line for the pilot subscription. We need PDF invoices (no EDI).

Billing details:
GreenLogistics, Inc.
220 Harbor Drive, Suite 400
Seattle, WA 98101
Tax ID: 91-2345678
Billing email for invoices: billing@greenlogistics.com

I'll ask procurement to attach a sample PO template — cc'ing Emily (finance) who will push the PO internally.

Best,
Alex

On Sun, Mar 1, 2026 at 09:12 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference> wrote:
> Alex — great to meet earlier...


From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Greene <agreene@greenlogistics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 08:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement & invoicing: pilots — PO vs card and invoice requirements

Alex / Emily — thanks for the quick reply and billing info. Two quick follow-ups:
1) Can procurement attach a sample PO template so our billing ops can validate field names? (PO number placement and billing contact are the most common mismatches.)
2) We'll prepare our standard invoice sample and attach our W-9. Do you have a preferred vendor setup portal (Ariba, Coupa, manual vendor form)?

I've attached redwood-invoice-sample.pdf (shows PO number placement) and will have Rishi begin vendor setup once we have any extra vendor forms.

Attachment: redwood-invoice-sample.pdf

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference


From: Emily Park <emily.park@greenlogistics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Alex Greene <agreene@greenlogistics.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement & invoicing: pilots — PO vs card and invoice requirements

Hi Marissa — attaching our PO template and vendor onboarding contact.

Attachment: GL_PO_template.pdf

Vendor setup: procurement@greenlogistics.com (Karen Lee, Senior Purchaser)
Portal: manual vendor form is fine for us; no Ariba/Coupa required for pilot-sized engagements.

Finance notes: please include our tax ID on the invoice and remit to the billing address Alex pasted earlier. Net-30 is acceptable. Also please send your W-9 to procurement@greenlogistics.com for vendor creation.

Regards,
Emily Park
Finance Manager, GreenLogistics


From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Greene <agreene@greenlogistics.com>, Emily Park <emily.park@greenlogistics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>, procurement@greenlogistics.com
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement & invoicing: pilots — PO vs card and invoice requirements

Thanks Emily — appreciate the PO template. Confirming next steps from Redwood: 

- We'll accept PO-based purchase for the pilot and invoice to billing@greenlogistics.com with the PO number on the first line of the invoice.
- Net-30 terms accepted.
- We'll send our W-9 and vendor details to procurement@greenlogistics.com by EOD Tue, Mar 3.
- We'll attach a sample invoice PDF (matches your template) with the first invoice; please confirm the PO number when available so we can finalize the invoice.

Regarding marketplace: we'll keep the AWS Marketplace as an option after pilot; if you want marketplace pricing we can provide a separate quote. For procurement simplicity, proceed with direct PO for now.

If you can get the signed PO by Mar 10 we can schedule provisioning the week of Mar 15. If procurement needs an accelerated timeline, let us know and we can discuss temporary card payment while PO completes.

I'll loop our billing ops (Rishi) to start vendor setup once procurement confirms their form.

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0126
